425. Longest Common Presuf

Problem Statement:
We know what the longest common prefix is but what is the longest common presuf?

The longest common presuf is defined as follows:

Let us have n strings as follows:

S1

S2

S3

S4

....

Sn

For the above strings the longest common presuf defined as the maximal string which is a common prefix of odd numbered strings and when reversed the common suffix of even numbered strings

So for the example:

abcd (prefix is considered since it is 1st string-odd)

gcba (suffix is considered since it is 2nd string-even)

abhj (same as 1st string)

The longest common prefux is : ab
input_spec:
The first line contains two integers N,M denoting the number of strings and the maximum length of the string
The next N line contains a string in each line
output_spec:
Your output must consist of a single line
Output the longest common prefux for the given strings.
If no common prefux exists output: "No common prefux exists" (without quotes)
